news.title: Meta settles social media addiction case with California, other states for $16.7 billion
news.summary: Meta and state attorneys general settled a federal trial centering on allegations that company misrepresented the extent of child-related mental health harms.

news.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge shows core prices rose 3.3% annually in July
news.summary: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to rise 0.1% monthly and 3.6% on a 12-month basis, according to economists surveyed by Dow Jones.

news.title: Mark Walter's TWG Global blasts 'attacks,' insists 'no fraud' amid federal probe
news.summary: Billionaire Los Angeles Dodgers owner Mark Walter has faced media scrutiny since he said he would sell his majority share of the LA Lakers. Walter is also the owner of the Los Angeles Lakers.

news.title: Dollar and bond markets 'on edge' ahead of Jackson Hole as Bessent's market intervention piles pressure on Warsh
news.summary: Strategists said investors were approaching Jackson Hole “on the back foot" The U.S. Federal Reserve is set to hold its annual meeting in Jackson Hole, Wyoming.

news.title: Bill Gates warns ‘there is no plan’ for the ‘upheaval’ AI will cause
news.summary: Bill Gates warns governments are not adequately preparing for how AI could displace workers. Gates: AI could strain social systems and create global risks.

news.title: Home prices in Chicago have jumped more over the past year than in any other U.S. city
news.summary: Some markets, particularly in the Midwest, are seeing big gains. Nationally, home prices are rising at a slow pace as housing inventory remains relatively low.

news.title: Meta’s stock rises as the company settles in social-media addiction trial
news.summary: The social-media giant agreed to pay up to $16.68 billion as part of the settlement. The settlement is expected to be completed by the end of the year.

news.title: There’s so much betting against long-term bonds that a turnaround could catch investors off guard, says Citadel Securities
news.summary: Citadel Securities’ strategist Frank Flight says a bet that appears to be one-sided against long-term bonds could be setting up for a painful unwind.

news.title: The renter generation: Young Americans, shut out of homeownership, brace to rent forever
news.summary: People once believed if they worked hard, they could become homeowners, but 'we’re coming to terms with the fact that perhaps most won’t. And that’s the new normal'

news.title: ‘The relationship quickly deteriorated’: My friend’s lawyer settled his injury case without his consent. What can he do?
news.summary: “His former lawyer is now holding the settlement funds, maintaining that he is entitled to attorney’s fees,” the lawsuit says.
